text: The lactose is crystallised from milk lactose as for any pharmaceutical lactose, then only the physical size is changed: sieving or air classification for coarse carrier, milling and micronising for fines. Grade names are supplier-specific (MEGGLE, DFE).

steps.name: sieve or mill
steps.note: The lactose is sieved to a narrow size range for the coarse carriers (InhaLac 70, 120), milled for the fine ones (InhaLac 400, Lactohale 400 from anhydrous lactose), or ground to tiny particles for InhaLac 500.
